Applicant :- Sharad Yadav And 2 Others Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Shikher Trivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Prasad Yadav Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned counsel for the opposite party as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No.0364 of 2022, under sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Bidhnu,
District Kanpur Nagar, during the pendency of investigation.

sentences.text: Facts in brief are that applicant no.1 & 3 were operating a company namely M/s Sharad & Group Green City Land Developers Pvt. Ltd, Kanpur Nagar and were dealing in business of selling plots of land.

sentences.text: On the the basis of that registered sale deed the mutation proceedings were completed and the name of present informant was entered into revenue record.
Later on, the original tenure holder of arazi no.335 Laxman gave a notice to the informant in the year 2018 that he never executed any sale deed regarding the aforesaid land.
When the informant went to the applicant no.2 for return of his money the applicants objected and did not return the money to him and applicant no.2 also threatened him.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the land in question was sold in favour of the informant in the year 2016 through sale deed which was executed by Laxman who was tenure holder of arazi no.335 and on the basis of which entry in revenue record was also transferred through mutation proceedings.

Further submitted that after lapse of five years present F.I.R. has been lodged by the informant against the applicants though applicant no.1 has not received any money from the informant and applicant no.3 had nothing to do with the transaction except he being a marginal witness.

Likewise, applicant no.2 has been implicated in this case only on account of being father of the applicant no.1 while making false allegation that he had shown the aforesaid land with other applicants to the informant.
It is also submitted that till now no suit for cancellation of sale deed has been filed by the real tenure holder.
In this way, the applicants have committed no offence and they are innocent.
Now investigation is going on, therefore, applicants are under apprehension of imminent arrest.
In case, the applicants are released on bail, they would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the investigation.

Learned counsel for the opposite party as well as learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid and urged that in this case the applicants were operating the real estate company named as aforesaid and the plot of land measuring 100 sq. yard pertaining to arazi no.335 was sold to the informant by mis-personating the real tenure holder Laxman.

Further urged that the sale deed was executed by an imposter and consideration money was received by applicant no.1 Sharad Yadav in his account through cheque which was given by the informant amounting to Rs.3,25,000/- and the same was also got mentioned in the sale deed.

It shows that the consideration money was also received by applicant no.1 at the time of execution of sale deed on the place of real tenure holder Laxman and sale deed was executed by an imposter regarding which an agreement to sale was made by the applicant no.1 himself with the informant on the basis of power of attorney.

It is also urged that the applicants themselves got the mutation done in favour of the informant but during investigation it was found that the real tenure holder was some other person than the person who executed the sale deed.
In this way, the prima facie case is established against the applicants, therefore, they are not entitled for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. and from perusal of record, it appears that in this case the applicant no.1 & 3 were operating the real estate company namely M/s Sharad & Group Green City Land Developers Pvt. Ltd, Kanpur Nagar dealing in the business of purchasing and selling plots.

Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application on behalf of applicant nos.1 & 3 is, hereby, rejected.
